name: AmCham Singapore
summary: American Chamber of Commerce — policy briefings, sector committees, and professional networks for US-linked business in Singapore.
body: AmCham is the US business community’s institutional hub: policy briefings, sector committees, and large networking calendars. Belonging here is professional rather than family-sport — useful when you have BD targets or want committee visibility, expensive if you only show up for the holiday party. Corporate memberships dominate; verify individual/SME options and fee schedules live. Pair with a nationality association or social club if you need friendship infrastructure, and with the chambers guide for a six-month ROI test.
membershipNotes: Corporate memberships dominate; individual options vary — check current fees before joining.
